groups.name: wow.analytics.catalog
groups.description: The analytics catalog service's settings, `wow.analytics.catalog.*`: the warehouse whose tables and views are the sources, the accounts trusted to describe them, how the catalog watches them, and its datasets.

groups.name: wow.analytics.catalog.datasets
groups.description: The datasets: where their views are created, how long a retired one is kept, and whether this node serves them.

groups.name: wow.analytics.catalog.datasets.serving
groups.description: Whether this node serves the published datasets' queries.

groups.name: wow.analytics.catalog.watch
groups.description: How the catalog watches the warehouse for changed tables.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.connection
properties.description: The name of the warehouse connection, the first part of each source's id.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.databases
properties.description: The databases whose tables and views are sources; `wow.clickhouse.database` when empty.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.datasets.database
properties.description: The warehouse database the datasets' views are created in.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.datasets.reconcile-interval
properties.description: How often this node reads every published dataset.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.datasets.refresh-interval
properties.description: How often this node reads which published datasets changed.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.datasets.retention
properties.description: How long a retired dataset's views are kept before they are dropped.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.datasets.serving.enabled
properties.description: Whether this node serves the published datasets' queries.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.refresh-interval
properties.description: How often the catalog compares `system.tables` and `wow_catalog` with what it saw last and brings each changed table's source up to date.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.require-publication-approval
properties.description: Whether every publication takes an approver (`ApproveDatasetPublication`); a publication that computes from sensitive values or lowers a protection takes one either way.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.require-source-approval
properties.description: Whether a dataset reads only the sources an approver approved (`ApproveSource`).

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.trusted-writers
properties.description: By warehouse account, the contexts whose tables the `wow_catalog` rows of that account are trusted to describe: the account each context's Sink inserts as. Nobody is trusted by default.

properties.name: wow.analytics.catalog.watch.enabled
properties.description: Whether the catalog watches the warehouse for changed tables at all.
